title: Add support for unmasking read-only paths to --security-opt unmask
body:
#### What type of PR is this?

/kind feature

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

- Allows unmasking "read-only" paths. This may be desired if running programs inside a container that want to mount /proc elsewhere, which requires not having other filesystems on top of /proc. I don't know of another way to do this without modifying buildah.
- The existing documentation for security-opt unmask claims to be able to unmask "read-only" paths, but in reality it does not, so it was misleading - see the change in docs/.

#### How to verify it

Containerfile:
```
FROM alpine:latest
RUN mount | grep proc
```

The following command from the same directory then shows read-only paths are mounted on top of /proc: 
`buildah build --security-opt=unmask=all .`

e.g.
```
proc on /proc/sys type proc (ro,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime)
```

Rerun with built binary from this patch and see only one mount on /proc as expected.

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:

I have submitted this as a PR instead of an issue.

#### Special notes for your reviewer:

Your feedback on this is very welcome, as I have not contributed here before.
In particular, I would like to raise that the `unmask=all` option to `podman run` will also unmask read-only paths so maybe this is what should be done instead here.
Thanks.

#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?

Maybe?

```release-note
Fixed security-opt unmask to unmask read-only paths as claimed in existing documentation
```

comments.body:
> I don't think adding a new option is the right thing, the basic unmask should be enough. That is how it is implemented in podman and what the docs claim.

Fair enough, I suspected that might be the case, but as an outsider didn't want to change existing behaviour. I've updated this PR to only do that, much less to review! :)
